WITH date_ranges AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    MIN(txn_date)::DATE as min_date,
    MAX(txn_date)::DATE as max_date
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    dr.customer_id,
    (dr.min_date + d.n::INTEGER * INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE as txn_date
  FROM date_ranges dr
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER () - 1 as n
    FROM generate_series(0, 999)
  ) d
  WHERE (dr.min_date + d.n::INTEGER * INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE <= dr.max_date
),
daily_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    txn_date::DATE as d_txn_date,
    SUM(CASE 
      WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
      WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount 
      WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
      ELSE 0 
    END) as net_change
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date::DATE
),
daily_balances_raw AS (
  SELECT 
    ad.customer_id,
    ad.txn_date,
    COALESCE(dc.net_change, 0) as net_change
  FROM all_dates ad
  LEFT JOIN daily_changes dc 
    ON ad.customer_id = dc.customer_id AND ad.txn_date = dc.d_txn_date
),
daily_balances AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    txn_date,
    SUM(net_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) as balance
  FROM daily_balances_raw
),
daily_balances_clamped AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    txn_date,
    GREATEST(balance, 0) as balance
  FROM daily_balances
),
monthly_max AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    date_trunc('month', txn_date)::DATE as month_start,
    MAX(balance) as max_daily_balance
  FROM daily_balances_clamped
  GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', txn_date)::DATE
)
SELECT 
  month_start,
  SUM(max_daily_balance) as monthly_total
FROM monthly_max
GROUP BY month_start
ORDER BY month_start
